Stop: Stopped; the CAV halts at a way point; Resume does not move it
Suspend: Suspended; the CAV halts at a way point
a Destination changed while driving: the new Routes proposed, the CAV driving on; the one selected driven to arrival
a place the map does not have: no Route proposed; the CAV stands
arrival: Arrived told; the CAV stands at the Destination; no collision
the Routes proposed: the one of least time first, an alternative; each segment timed
